messages:
Sofia Martin: quick thought  team happy hour + puzzle exchange next Thursday? 6:30pm, office common room.
Sofia Martin: idea is bring a small puzzle (500-1000 piece or a board game you'd swap) and a snack to share. low-key. :puzzle_piece:
Ethan Blake: love the puzzle exchange idea! count me in. can bring pretzel bites and a 500-piece skyline puzzle.
Rina Kapoor: i'm in. i'll bring a 750-piece van gogh puzzle and a big tray of samosas (vegan).
Tom H.: 6:30 is tight for me, could we do 7pm? otherwise i might be late.
Sofia Martin: hmm 7pm ok for me. others?
Samira G.: 7pm better. i'll bring sparkling water + mocktail mixers.
Ethan Blake: 7 works. also can bring a compact speaker for background music.
Sofia Martin: sweet. i'll make a doodle to lock the date, and patch in a signup for puzzles (to avoid duplicates). link after i create it.
Tom H.: can someone bring a roll of tape and scissors? i never have them when i need to wrap puzzle swaps.
Rina Kapoor: i'll bring tape and some zip bags for pieces.
party-bot: Reminder set: Puzzle Exchange Happy Hour  days before event.
Sofia Martin: yay! this will be a fun midweek unwind. gif: :cozy-fire:
